{{short description|Mathematician}}
'''Donna Marie Testerman''' (born 1960){{r|born}} is a mathematician specializing in the [[representation theory]] of [[algebraic group]]s. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] in Switzerland.{{r|epfl}}

Testerman completed her Ph.D. at the [[University of Oregon]] in 1985. Her dissertation, ''Certain Embeddings of Simple Algebraic Groups'', was supervised by [[Gary Seitz]].{{r|mg}} As a faculty member at [[Wesleyan University]], she won a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 1992.{{r|sloan}}

== Research ==
{{Expand section|date=June 2026}}
<!-- lists date received if known -->
In 1992, Testerman proved that if ''G'' is a [[semisimple algebraic group]] over an [[algebraically closed field]] ''k'' of characteristic ''p'' and ''p'' is a [[Good prime (algebraic groups)|good prime]] for ''G'', and ''u'' is an element of ''G'' satisfying <math>u^p = 1</math>, then there exists a [[subgroup]] ''X'' of ''G'' which is isomorphic to the [[special linear group]] <math>SL_2(k)</math> or to the [[projective special linear group]] <math>PSL_2(k)</math>.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Testerman |first=Donna |date=1995 |title=A1-type Overgroups of Elements of Order p in Semisimple Algebraic Groups and the Associated Finite Groups |url=https://infoscience.epfl.ch/server/api/core/bitstreams/a53f845a-2f90-4716-9a86-b503d1090400/content |journal=Journal of Algebra |volume=177 |pages=34-76}}</ref> Testerman also proved a variant theorem where one may take a surjective [[endomorphism]] <math>\sigma</math> that fixes ''u'', and conclude that <math>\sigma(X)\subseteq X</math>.<ref name=":0" />

In 1993, [[Martin W. Liebeck]], [[Jan Saxl]], and Testerman classified all simple, closed, connected subgroups ''X'' of a [[simple algebraic group]] ''G'' over an algebraically closed field ''k'' in the case where <math>rank(X)\geq\frac{1}{2}rank(G)</math> in terms of a [[subsystem subgroup]] of ''G'' in which ''X'' is a subset.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Liebeck |first=Martin W. |last2=Saxl |first2=Jan |last3=Testerman |first3=Donna M. |date=March 1996 |title=Simple Subgroups of Large Rank in Groups of Lie Type |url=http://doi.wiley.com/10.1112/plms/s3-72.2.425 |journal=Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society |language=en |volume=s3-72 |issue=2 |pages=425–457 |doi=10.1112/plms/s3-72.2.425}}</ref> In particular, there are only finitely many such [[conjugacy classes]], except in the case where ''X'' is [[D4 (root system)|D4]], ''G'' is [[E7 (mathematics)|E7]], and the characteristic is 2.<ref name=":1" /> Using similar methods, the three authors were also able to use similar methods to classify subgroups ''X'' of a finite [[group of Lie type]] that is [[Quasisimple group|quasisimple]] where <math>rank(X)\geq\frac{1}{2}rank(G)</math>.<ref name=":1" />

== Books ==
Testerman is an author or editor of several books and book-length research monographs in mathematics, including:
* ''Irreducible subgroups of exceptional algebraic groups'' (1988){{r|isg}}
* ''<math>A_1</math> subgroups of exceptional algebraic groups'' (1999){{r|a1s}}
* ''Centres of centralizers of unipotent elements in simple algebraic groups'' (2011){{r|ccu}}
* ''Group Representation Theory'' (2007){{r|grt}}
* ''Linear algebraic groups and finite groups of Lie type'' (2011){{r|lag}}
